name: stackpulse-server
description: StackPulse REST API backend with PostgreSQL and GitHub integration

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/db', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('src/db/schema.sql')) fs.copyFileSync('src/db/schema.sql', 'dist/db/schema.sql');"
